artifacts.summary: 5-phase documentation plan adding a bidirectional consolidation-versus-division test as Component 0 of multi-task-creation-standard.md and wiring it into /task (create + expand), /errors, /meta and /fix-it, plus deploy verification.

memory_candidates.content: Architectural anti-pattern found in this agent-system: a mechanism that REACTS to proposed-task file_scope overlap (multi-task-creation-standard.md Component 4a adds a serializing dependency edge between overlapping tasks) without any upstream step that QUESTIONS whether the split should have happened at all. The result is a self-defeating division: two findings sharing one edit target become two tasks that the system's own in-batch file_scope_collision check then serializes, so they were never independently dispatchable. General lesson for pipeline design: when a downstream stage can only mitigate a bad upstream decision (serialize rather than merge), add the decision test upstream of it rather than strengthening the mitigation. Related: fuzzy clustering keys (shared key terms, component_type, affected_area) systematically miss the sharper structural signals (shared narrow file target, shared acceptance gate) that actually determine dispatchability.
